::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `CropImageBorders` {-}

Removes the solid border surrounding a scanned image and saves the result to another image file. Returns true if image was successfully saved.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean CropImageBorders(string inputImagePath,
                         string outputImagePath,
                         number colorTolerance)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputImagePath |  | 
| `string` outputImagePath |  | 
| `number` colorTolerance |  |


:::
